key_props: plaster busts on a stone shelf
wine bottle and fruit on a wooden table
visual_synopsis: The sketch opens as raw black-and-white camera footage with a REC timecode burn-in, then goes to color: a TV crew - a young woman reporter in glasses with a yellow microphone and a cameraman on a tripod - interviews a big-mustached man in a pinstripe jacket sitting on a village garden veranda lined with plaster busts and bottles. Through the interview a frizzy-haired village wife played in drag keeps bursting out of the sunlit orchard behind them to shout her piece at the camera, ending on a wide shot of the whole shoot.
